{{Quote|A trap! We're in Darth Vader's trap!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="DVS" />}}
A '''mission''' to the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] took place during the [[Yavin blockade]], as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] managed to acquire the plans of the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The mission was the first encounter between Luke Skywalker and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Lord Vader advances himself at the expense of me and my fellow officers! Even now, in the great starship yards of Fondor... He has begun the Empire's largest project since the Death Star... A project aimed at your destruction, Rebels!|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff|Griff]], to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]|<ref name="DVS" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff]] served [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] as an agent provocateur on the industrial planet of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], a role in which he proved successful. The planet was the location of the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]], where the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] new [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was nearing completion. Admiral Griff infiltrated a cell of traitorous Imperial admirals involved in the ''Executor''{{'s}} construction, regularly reporting on them to the [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader. The officers were not very sympathetically inclined towards the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but were growing frustrated of Vader's [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|unique position]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial naval]] pyramid. By feigning he too shared their disdain of Vader and helping them organizing their operations successfully, Griff eventually became the conspirators' leader.<ref name="DVS" />

[[File:Admirals_plot.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Imperial admirals plotting against Vader.]]

As the [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was lasting more time than initially expected, the traitorous officers decided to create a plot to humiliate the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], by offering the schematics of Vader's new flagship, the ''Executor'', to the Rebels. They then sent a [[drone craft]] to the Rebels besieged on Yavin 4 with that offer. Although the Rebels suspected a trap, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] volunteered to carry the mission to Fondor.<ref name="DVS" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|The arrival of the Rebel spy is good news... And a credit to the effectiveness of the scene we staged at the meeting with your fellow admirals.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff|Griff]]|<ref name="DVS" />}}
Luke Skywalker thus traveled to Fondor in a [[Civilian craft (Fondor)|civilian craft]] with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. When they arrived in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]], Skywalker was contacted by Admiral Griff, still posing as an ally of the Reion. The officer helped the young man to access the planet and met him at the surface. During the first discussions, Griff lured Skywalker and convinced him that the Rebels could also sabotage the ''Executor'' before its completion. As Admiral Griff realized the identity of the Rebel agent, he conceived a new plan to trap the Rebel hero. His idea was to organize a meeting between Skywalker and the conspirators in order to directly incriminate the traitorous officers and capture the Rebel hero as well. Vader agreed with Griff's plan and decided to personally supervise the operation.<ref name="DVS" />

Luke Skywalker then met the Imperial officers in [[Fondor's underground steam tubes]]. As Vader was deploying [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the area, Skywalker felt his powerful dark presence through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The young man decided to cancel the meeting but the traitorous officers refused to consider his warnings. When Imperial troops finally attacked, Skywalker therefore avoided capture while all conspirators were arrested. Thanks to the intervention of [[Tanith Shire]], a young Fondorian woman and Rebel sympathizer, who blinded the stormtroopers by liberating steam in the tunnels, the young Rebel managed to escape the Fondor's underground steam tubes.<ref name="DVS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Whoever he is, the Force is with him. And eventually I wasn't prepared for this time.|Darth Vader|<ref name="DVS" />}}
Luke Skywalker, R2-D2, C-3PO and Tanith Shire eventually left the Fondor system in a stolen [[StarHauler-class drone barge/Legends|drone barge]], bringing the ''Executor'' schematics with them. Admiral Griff's operation was a complete failure since Skywalker escaped with the plans. On the other hand, Darth Vader was very troubled after feeling the presence of his son for the first time. The Sith Lord understood that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] might have trained a [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] and this could be more dangerous for the Empire than anything else.<ref name="DVS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although it is represented on the cover of the [[1992]] reprint, [[Classic Star Wars 4]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] doesn't confront [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]].
